items.name: research-figures
items.title: Research Figures
items.description: Produce publication-grade figures for a thesis or paper from result data: matplotlib with a consistent, colour-blind-safe style file, vector output sized to the text width, one figure per claim, variance shown, direct labels over legends, and captions that carry the argument; plus TikZ for architecture and method diagrams. Use when a results section needs figures, when a supervisor calls a plot unreadable, or when the document's figures do not match each other.
items.author: Khaled Saeed
